basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student currently navigating my way through my fifth year at Grand Valley State University, majoring in Marketing with a minor in Film. Originally from Michigan, I'm passionate about storytelling and visual media, often experimenting with video editing software in my free time. When I'm not studying or attending classes, I enjoy reading self-help books by authors like Joseph Murphy and following the latest paint trends by Sherwin-Williams. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after winding down from a busy day. I'm single and focused on my education and career aspirations.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My academic background in Marketing and Film has equipped me with a solid understanding of digital media and consumer behavior. I often complement my studies with online resources and communities like Reddit to gain practical insights. Additionally, my part-time work in a local paint store has given me a working knowledge of color theory and interior design.
